course.title: L77 Present, Ready, Slow, and Beautiful
course.description: 用当前状态、动作速度、规则、步骤、等待、年轻和美丽判断 present、quick、ready、regular、second、slow、sudden、waiting、young、beautiful。 场景：学员看一张日程状态图，描述人是否在场、是否准备好、动作快慢、变化是否突然，以及花是否美。 目标词：present, quick, ready, regular, second, slow, sudden, waiting, young, beautiful。核心句型：Are you ...? / I am ... because ... / ... is different from ... / This is the ... / ... gives ... / ... is not ...。
